title: Flow, and coding in the zone
principle: Clear goals, immediate feedback and a challenge matched to skill produce the zone — so a methodology's job is to protect those three conditions, not to optimise throughput.

anchor.title: Flow: The Psychology of Optimal Experience
anchor.author: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi
anchor.note: The book is the anchor for the *state*. [Victor's talk](../bret-victor/index.html) is the anchor for the *mechanism*, and has its own entry — this one is where the two meet.
